text.content:
Available 1st level · Bramble-armored, slow, extremely hard to move

Speed 20 ft · AC +2 item · Athletics +2 circumstance to Grapple and to resist forced movement · Melee thorn-arm (agile, reach 10 ft) 2d6 piercing

Green load

10 temporary Hit Points, renewing each round while the needle stays on Green. Bramble grows as fast as it's cut away.

Grey load

Your thorn-arm deals +1d6 persistent bleed, and creatures that Grapple you or hit you unarmed take 1d6 persistent bleed. Dead thorn is dirtier than live thorn.
